# Computergaga

> > Computergaga is a comprehensive online learning platform specializing in Excel, Power BI, and VBA training for professionals at all skill levels.

Founded by Alan Murray, Computergaga offers structured online courses, practical tutorials, and free resources to help learners master Excel formulas, dashboards, PivotTables, and business intelligence tools. The platform combines video instruction with downloadable learning materials and real-world Excel applications.

## Key Topics

- Excel
- Power BI
- VBA
- PivotTables
- Power Query
- Power Pivot
- Formulas
- Dashboards
- Online Courses
- Data Analysis
- Spreadsheet Training
- Tips and Tricks
- Alan Murray
- Office
- Mail Merge

## Getting Started

- [Learn Excel Online - Excel Tips and Tricks | Computergaga](https://www.computergaga.com): Computergaga homepage offering Excel courses, tutorials, and tips on formulas, dashboards, and Power BI.
- [About Alan Murray - Computergaga](https://www.computergaga.com/about): About Alan Murray, Computergaga founder and Excel trainer, author of Advanced Excel Success.

## Online Courses & Training

- [Excel Online Courses - Learn Online Today | Computergaga](https://www.computergaga.com/online-courses): Computergaga's comprehensive Excel online courses from beginner to advanced with Power BI and VBA.

## Learning Resources

- [Free Downloads to help learn Excel | Computergaga](https://www.computergaga.com/free-downloads): Free Excel learning resources including downloadable booklet with 40 Excel tricks and tools.
